missing_or_ambiguous_contracts.question: A. Single production P1 model
evidence: scripts/beam/task1_v3_residual/train_residual_policy.py documents an historical V3A --final-fit path that labels Fold0 after replay and fits an all-fold public model.
The current task explicitly forbids Fold0 use, and this historical V3A final-fit procedure is neither canonical P1/P1F-R2 nor a P5 production-model contract.
reports/task1/step2p5a_reproducibility_report.json documents only fold-separated P1 inner models, not one persisted P5-compatible public P1 model or an allowed no-Fold0 final-fit procedure.
missing_or_ambiguous_contracts.required_decision: Specify an existing or newly professor-approved no-Fold0 production P1 fitting/loading contract; this preflight cannot invent one.

missing_or_ambiguous_contracts.question: B. Single production P4 proxy model
evidence: No persisted single public P4 beneficiality-proxy model, no final-fit manifest, and no code/config specifying how to fit or load one for public P5 inference was found in the inspected historical public/production pipeline.
missing_or_ambiguous_contracts.required_decision: Specify the exact frozen P4 production model provenance and allowed development-only fitting/loading procedure.

missing_or_ambiguous_contracts.question: C. K77 public action-space and 36-feature construction
evidence: Historical artifacts under artifacts/task1/recovery_096/final_public_v3/ implement the V3A public pipeline, not P5.
The inspected historical residual-policy code and final-public artifacts do not define a P5 public K77 action-space plus canonical frozen-36 P1/P4 feature-construction contract.
missing_or_ambiguous_contracts.required_decision: Specify the exact existing public K77 action/feature builder and provenance-equivalence checks for P5.

missing_or_ambiguous_contracts.question: D. One public-population threshold
evidence: reports/task1/step2p5_threshold_report.json defines four nested-OOF thresholds, each selected using a different three-fold inner population for its corresponding outer fold.
No report, workflow section, production manifest, or code path specifies a development-only rule that maps those four OOF thresholds to one threshold for the public population.
Averaging, selecting, re-optimizing, or otherwise deriving a public threshold would be a new rule and is forbidden by this task.
missing_or_ambiguous_contracts.required_decision: Specify the exact pre-existing development-only public threshold rule.

missing_or_ambiguous_contracts.question: E. P5 fused-action application to final Task1 top-5
evidence: scripts/beam/task1_v3_residual/train_residual_policy.py contains the historical residual-action-to-top5 conversion for V3A.
Its use for P5 depends on unresolved A-D and therefore cannot supply an executable P5 deployment contract by itself.
missing_or_ambiguous_contracts.required_decision: After A-D are resolved, identify the exact approved P5 action-selection/threshold input to the existing top-5 conversion contract.

reason: The repository does not contain a complete exact reproducible P5 public deployment contract. Proceeding would require inventing model-finalization, K77 public feature/action, and public-threshold rules.
